questions.explanation: After 'insist' the subjunctive uses the base form: 'be', not 'is' or 'should be'.
questions.q: The committee insisted that the report ___ published immediately.

questions.explanation: 'It is essential that' triggers the subjunctive base form in formal style.
options: It is essential that he attend
It is essential that he attends
It is essential that he will attend
It is essential for him attending
questions.q: Choose the correct formal sentence.

questions.explanation: After 'recommended', formal English uses the bare subjunctive 'submit'.
questions.q: The auditors recommended that she ___ the amended accounts.

questions.explanation: 'Lest' takes the subjunctive (base form) to express a feared outcome.
questions.q: She rehearsed daily ___.

questions.explanation: 'Demand' belongs to the mandative group: 'that he resign', not 'resigns'.
questions.q: Which sentence uses the mandative subjunctive correctly?

questions.explanation: In wishes about the present, the past subjunctive 'were' is used with all persons.
questions.q: I wish the chairman ___ here to answer these questions.

questions.explanation: 'Propose' triggers the mandative subjunctive: base form 'adopt'.
questions.q: He proposed that the council ___ the new charter.

questions.explanation: 'God save the Queen' is a fixed formula with the present subjunctive.
questions.q: Choose the correct traditional formula.

questions.explanation: After 'request', formal style uses the subjunctive base form 'leave'.
questions.q: Select the correct formal sentence.

questions.explanation: In 'as if' clauses about an unreal present, the past subjunctive 'were' applies.
questions.q: He behaves as if he ___ the owner of the company.

questions.explanation: 'It is imperative that' requires the subjunctive base form.
questions.q: It is imperative that every delegate ___ on time.

questions.explanation: 'Be that as it may' is a fixed concessive subjunctive formula.
questions.q: Choose the correct fixed expression.

questions.explanation: 'Require' takes the mandative subjunctive: 'that all staff wear'.
options: requires that all staff will wear
questions.q: Choose the grammatically correct formal version.

questions.explanation: After 'suggest', the subjunctive base form 'be' is correct in formal registers.
questions.q: She suggested that the meeting ___ until Thursday.

questions.explanation: 'Long live' is a fixed optative subjunctive formula.
questions.q: Choose the correct traditional exclamation.

questions.explanation: 'If I were you' is the standard past-subjunctive advice formula.
questions.q: ___, I would accept the offer.

questions.explanation: 'Move' (in parliamentary language) takes the subjunctive: 'that the motion be carried'.
options: moved that the motion be carried
moved that the motion is carried
moved the motion to be carried
moved that the motion will be carried
questions.q: Which formal sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: 'Would rather' about others' actions takes the past subjunctive.
questions.q: I would rather you ___ at home this evening.

questions.explanation: 'It is crucial that' triggers the mandative subjunctive base form.
questions.q: It is crucial that he ___ the medicine regularly.

questions.explanation: In formal 'whether ... or' concessives, the subjunctive 'be' survives in set phrases.
questions.q: ___, rich or poor, all must obey the law.
